articles.title: Re-baselining your nanotune project after v1.7.0
articles.focus: A practitioner's guide to the new reproducible-by-default benchmark workflow: when to reach for --base vs a plain run vs compare, why existing pass rates will move, and how to rebuild a trustworthy baseline without losing old history.

articles.title: How nanotune training now survives a Ctrl+C without lying about it
articles.focus: A behind-the-scenes look at the signal-handling rewrite: why MLX checkpointing needed a graceful path, how the temp-file-then-rename pattern protects adapters and judge.json, and what the new exit-130 and second-Ctrl-C semantics actually do for users.

articles.title: Treating valid.jsonl as a real dataset, not a side effect
articles.focus: How the --eval flag across every data subcommand, the visible train/validation split, and the --fix and --rewrite-context repair flags turn the validation set into something you can actually curate, edit, and export alongside training data.
